desc:
Notice convening the 20th Annual General Meeting ('AGM') and Annual Report 2025-26.

We hereby inform you that the 20th AGM of the Company will be held on Monday, September 21, 2026 at 5.30 p.m. IST through Video Conferencing ('VC')/ Other Audio Visual Means ('OAVM'). 

Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 34 read with Paragraph A of Part A of Schedule III of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI LODR'), we are enclosing herewith the following:

1. Annual Report of the Company for the Financial Year ('FY') 2025-26.
2. Notice of AGM of the Company (including e-voting instructions).
Notice of 20th AGM of the Company to be held on Monday, September 21, 2026 at 5.30 pm IST is enclosed.
Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26 is enclosed.
Letter sent to members pursuant to Regulation 36(1)(b) of SEBI Listing Regulations is enclosed.
